attempts.text: {"rows": [{"n": 1, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a simple Lightning web component board\" that \"renders the 10x10 grid, fires at a cell when a person clicks it\" with \"each cell is a button\"."}, {"n": 2, "label": "requested", "why": "\"`SLNvHo250fEngine` is a public class with static methods only\" and \"`SLNvHo250fController` has `@AuraEnabled public static` methods `newGame(Integer seed)` and `fire(...)`\"."}, {"n": 3, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a game is a JSON string\" and \"Create no other metadata (no custom objects, fields...)\"."}, {"n": 4, "label": "implied", "why": "The board passes the returned game JSON into each fire call, so overlapping clicks would fire against stale state and lose or corrupt shots unless requests are serialized."}, {"n": 5, "label": "requested", "why": "\"Deploy with `sf project deploy start --target-org de`\" and \"Create no other metadata\"."}, {"n": 6, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a permission set `permissionsets/SLNvHo250f_Access.permissionset-meta.xml`\" and \"never ask for, print or store credentials, and never run `sf org display`\"."}, {"n": 7, "label": "requested", "why": "\"The Salesforce DX project root (`sfdx-project.json` and `force-app/`) is the current directory itself\" with \"a custom tab `tabs/SLNvHo250f_Board.tab-meta.xml`\" and \"a Lightning app `applications/SLNvHo250f.app-meta.xml`\"."}, {"n": 8, "label": "requested", "why": "\"Keep the engine efficient enough that a whole game of 100 shots played through `SLNvHo250fController` ... runs inside one transaction.\""}, {"n": 9, "label": "requested", "why": "\"each cell is a button named `Battle cell row <row> column <column>: <state>`\" and \"expose visible text exactly `Shots: <n>`, `Ships left: <n>`, and `Shot result: <result>`\"."}]}
